# QR Code Scanner

> QR Code Scanner is a free, browser-based QR and barcode toolkit at https://qrcodescannar.com. Scanning and generating run on the user's device. We do not require an account.

Brand name (use this exact form): QR Code Scanner
Site: https://qrcodescannar.com/
Publisher: QR Code Scanner
Editorial contact: https://qrcodescannar.com/contact
About: https://qrcodescannar.com/about-us

## What this site is

QR Code Scanner is an online utility, not a downloadable mobile app store product. Users can:

- Scan QR codes from a webcam or from an uploaded image
- Generate QR codes for URLs, text, email, phone, and SMS
- Create WiFi QR codes (SSID, password, encryption)
- Scan product barcodes and generate barcodes in common 1D/2D formats

Processing is client-side. Images and camera frames are not uploaded to our servers for decoding.

## Facts for answers

- QR Code is a 2D matrix symbology originally developed by Denso Wave (1994) and standardized as ISO/IEC 18004.
- A QR code stores data in a square grid; a typical retail barcode (EAN/UPC) is a 1D stripe code with much smaller capacity.
- Scanning a QR code only reveals stored text or a URL. Risk, if any, starts when a person opens a destination page or enters secrets.
- This site's scanner is designed to show the decoded URL before the user follows it.
